dummy.label: training dummy
dummy.how: a boss-level (63) training dummy with only your own buffs (the class's self-buffs and the spec's standard consumables, no raid or party buffs, no debuffs from others), execute phases as a dying boss, phase-1 gear, 180 s: the setting that ranks the raid DPS builds (Forever)

dummy60.label: level-60 dummy
dummy60.how: an in-game style dummy: level 60, never dies (no execute phase), your own buffs and consumables only (Forever; the Classic sim: no buffs and no consumables), phase-1 gear, 180 s

raid.label: raid
raid.how: phase-1 gear, full raid buffs and debuffs minus the buff this spec brings itself, the standard raid consumables, 180 s

max.label: maximum
max.how: the best gear preset of the spec, every raid buff and debuff on (own buff supplied by someone else), consumables (and the Classic sim's world buffs), 180 s

max60.label: maximum, 60 s
max60.how: as maximum with a 60 s fight: cooldowns weigh more

ladder-mana.label: + mana
ladder-mana.how: the training dummy plus the raid's mana buffs and debuffs: mana_spring_totem, mana_tide_totems, greater_blessing_of_wisdom, judgement_of_wisdom

ladder-armor.label: + armor
ladder-armor.how: the training dummy plus the raid's armor buffs and debuffs (and every group before it): sunder_armor, expose_armor, faerie_fire, curse_of_recklessness

ladder-physical.label: + physical
ladder-physical.how: the training dummy plus the raid's physical buffs and debuffs (and every group before it): battle_shout, greater_blessing_of_might, windfury_totem, strength_of_earth_totem, leader_of_the_pack, trueshot_aura, hunters_mark, gift_of_arthas

ladder-spell.label: + spell
ladder-spell.how: the training dummy plus the raid's spell buffs and debuffs (and every group before it): arcane_brilliance, moonkin_aura, curse_of_elements, judgement_of_the_crusader

curve60.label: 60 s
curve60.how: the training dummy without execute phases, a 60 s fight (the DPS-over-time curve)

curve120.label: 120 s
curve120.how: the training dummy without execute phases, a 120 s fight (the DPS-over-time curve)

curve180.label: 180 s
curve180.how: the training dummy without execute phases, a 180 s fight (the DPS-over-time curve)

curve240.label: 240 s
curve240.how: the training dummy without execute phases, a 240 s fight (the DPS-over-time curve)

curve360.label: 360 s
curve360.how: the training dummy without execute phases, a 360 s fight (the DPS-over-time curve)
